mistake.label: False Positive & Testing
mistake.desc: Detection due to security vulnerability checks or system errors
mistake.guide: If it was for testing purposes, please attach the test plan or related instructions. If it's a system error, an error screenshot is required.

[Incident Details]
Accessed with a test account to perform '000' action for security check.

[References]
Quarterly Security Vulnerability Check Plan (Doc No: 23-04-001)

keys.SECRET_KEY: Secret key for JWT token signing and security encryption
keys.ENCRYPTION_KEY: Data encryption key (for secure logs/secrets storage)
keys.CORS_ORIGINS: Allowed CORS origin domain list (comma separated)
keys.ALLOWED_FILE_EXTENSIONS: Allowed file upload extensions (with dot, comma separated)
keys.MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB: Maximum single file upload size (in MB)
keys.UPLOAD_DIR: Directory path where uploaded files are stored
keys.ENTRA_REDIRECT_URI: Redirect URI after Entra ID login
keys.GRAPH_MAIL_SENDER: Shared mailbox email address with Mail.Send permission
keys.APP_URL: Frontend URL used for links in emails
keys.LOG_LEVEL: Log recording level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR)
keys.INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL: Initial administrator email created on first run
keys.INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD: Initial administrator password created on first run
keys.CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND: Celery task result storage backend URL
keys.SMTP_HOST: SMTP host address for outbound emails
keys.SMTP_PORT: SMTP port number for outbound emails
keys.VITE_API_URL: API server base URL for frontend client
keys.VITE_ENTRA_CLIENT_ID: Entra ID Client ID for frontend
keys.VITE_ENTRA_TENANT_ID: Entra ID Tenant ID for frontend
